full_judgment: 5. The defendant No. 3 contested the suit by filing written statement who by denying all the material allegations of the plaint and admitting the statement made in the written statement filed by the defendant No. 1 contended inter alia, that the plaintiff is the brother-in-law of the defendant No. 3. The defendant No.3 married the maternal cousin sister of the plaintiff and has two sons by the said wife. But although he has divorced the said wife yet he maintained a good relationship with the plaintiff. He also purchased the adjacent landed property in the same suit khatian through negotiation made by the plaintiff from its owner Abdur Rahman who signed the purchase deed as a attesting witness. The defendant No. 3 further claimed that he has purchased the suit property on the negotiation of the plaintiff, who being the sitting tenant of the suit property negotiated the entire sale. The talk of sale was held at the suit but in presence of the plaintiff. He paid Taka 18,000 to the seller Raja Kha and obtained a bainapatra on 1-1-1979 with the full knowledge of the plaintiff. The plaintiff thereafter admitted the defendant No. 3 as his landlord and agreed to pay the rent consequent to which he has paid Taka 1,000 as monthly rent to the defendant No. 3 till 30th Chaitra 1388 BS. On 14-11-1979 the defendant No. 3 obtained two Saf kabala in the name of his three minor sons finalizing the purchase and while he was preparing to construct a two- storied building in the suit land by obtaining approved plan from the Municipality upon paying the holding tax and mutating the name of his sons, the father-in-law of the defendant No. 3 Habibur Rahman became furious and with his collaboration the plaintiff created bainapatra showing a false claim that the defendant Raja Kha to have executed the same and filed the instant suit.
